requirement_coverage.instructions: Does this design element address a cited requirement?

criteria.directly_required: A cited requirement (worktask, HLD, spec) explicitly asks for this
criteria.implicitly_needed: Not explicitly stated but required for the architecture to work correctly
criteria.nice_to_have: Improves the design but no requirement depends on it
criteria.not_required: No requirement asks for this — it is speculative or over-engineered

design_necessity.instructions: Is this design element necessary for the system to function correctly?

criteria.essential: System cannot work correctly without this element
criteria.important: Significantly improves correctness, reliability, or extensibility
criteria.beneficial: A reasonable design choice but alternatives would also work
criteria.unnecessary: Adds complexity without proportional benefit — YAGNI violation

architectural_value.instructions: What is the overall architectural value of including this element in the plan?
criteria: harmful — introduces coupling, violates boundaries, or creates maintenance burden
neutral — neither helps nor hurts the architecture meaningfully
positive — improves the architecture with reasonable trade-offs
high — critical architectural element that the design depends on
